name: Attach a project-context doc to an agent, run it, and see the doc in the run trace
description: Opens the seeded Security Reviewer, ticks the fixture doc docs/e2e-invariant.md on its Context tab (written by scripts/e2e.sh / e2e-web.yml into DEVDIGEST_CLONE_DIR), runs that agent on PR #482 and opens the run's trace. The server resolves attached docs BEFORE the LLM provider, so the run (which fails without an API key in the hermetic stack) still records them: the trace's 'Specs read' row lists the path and the 'Project context' prompt block contains the fixture marker E2E-INVARIANT-7f3a (AC-41, AC-46). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo. NOTE: with a real provider key present locally the run makes a real LLM call; the flow passes either way.

navigate to the PR detail route
run the agent with the attached doc

the attached doc path is listed
